Put your 20 photos here!

Save the photos you sent in chat as:
  photo-01.jpg
  photo-02.jpg
  ...
  photo-20.jpg

Accepted: .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp (the site auto-tries all)

Tip: On Windows, just drag-drop the 20 images into this folder and rename them.

Optional music:
  Create folder: public/music/
  Add file: love.mp3  (any romantic song)
  Then press the 🎶 button on the site.

That's it — refresh http://localhost:3000 and enjoy ❤️
